# Citero

> Citero is a GEO (Generative Engine Optimization) and AI visibility tracking platform. We help brands track, analyze, and optimize their visibility, mentions, and citations across ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google Gemini, and Claude.

## Core Features

- [AI Visibility Tracking](https://citero.ai/brands) - Understand what AI models say about your brand and track brand mentions 24/7.
- [Competitor Comparison](https://citero.ai/competitors) - Compare competitor citation share and find gaps to steal traffic and customers.
- [Sentiment Analysis](https://citero.ai/sentiment) - Analyze brand sentiment, trust signals, and authority markers across AI engines.
- [Source & Citation Identification](https://citero.ai/sources) - Discover which websites and documents AI engines use as primary references, so you can optimize them directly.
- [Brand Audits](https://citero.ai/audits) - Weekly prioritized action items and brand audits showing how to rank higher in AI responses.
- [Prompt Simulator](https://citero.ai/prompts) - See what AI says about your brand across different models and query contexts.
